title: Attack
wikitext:
{{For|technical details about attack damage calculation|Combat/Mechanics}}
'''Attack''' [[File:Attack.png|24px]] is a statistic that affects how much damage the player does. It can be gained in a variety of ways.

Each level of Attack buff adds a flat 3 damage to a player's attacks, added after the multiplicative bonus of an [[Iridium Band]] but before the multiplicative bonuses of the [[Combat#Combat Skill|Fighter or Brute Professions]].
